preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c_i <= 10**9 for c_i in prices)
preconditions.description: Each price c_i must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, and each edge must connect valid vertices.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum cost s, the number of vertices k, and the indices of the vertices in increasing order.
The minimum cost s must be non-negative.
The number of vertices k must be at least 1.
